systems.owner: Direction générale de la Modernisation de l'Etat civil (DGMEC)
systems.tiers: commune of Léo: 152,543 civil-status documents (all birth, marriage and death registers) scanned and archived, 18 to 23 August 2025

systems.system: Unique civil-status identifier (provided for in the draft Code des personnes et de la famille)

note: The bill debated on 1 September 2025 would allow birth acts to be recorded in digital registers, which is a legal provision and not a system in use; the operation described at Léo is back-capture of existing registers.
